items.desc: Over 80 Buddhist nuns at the monastery in western Kathmandu blend daily kung fu practice with meditation, disaster relief, environmental advocacy, and skills traditionally associated with men.

items.title: Shah likely to skip guard of honour, airport farewell for India visit
items.desc: No formal ceremony is planned so far for a guard of honour ahead of the state visit.

items.title: Indian border restrictions stall development projects in Tinkar, Chhangru
items.desc: Drinking water projects and a suspension bridge in Darchula’s northern villages remain incomplete after SSB personnel stopped construction materials from entering Nepal despite diplomatic clearance.

items.title: Nepal to seek measures to boost exports during PM’s India visit
items.desc: Kathmandu plans to seek easier access for Nepali products, resolve certification hurdles, review anti-dumping duties on jute goods and expand access to Indian ports.

items.title: Malan’s 71 takes Chitwan to 133 against Sudurpaschim
items.desc: Chitwan Rhinos set the Royals a target of 134 in Qualifier 2, with the winner advancing to the final against Lumbini Lions.

items.title: Nepal plans to let investors trade rights entitlements on stock exchange
items.desc: The move would permit shareholders unable or unwilling to buy additional shares a chance to earn money from their entitlements instead of letting them go unused.

items.title: Trump, Xi, Putin conclude historic meeting on Ukraine war, nuclear arms
items.desc: The leaders discussed Ukraine, nuclear disarmament and regional conflicts, but deep divisions over security, trade and Taiwan cast doubt on whether the unprecedented meeting would produce concrete agreements.

items.title: Fatal crashes keep claiming lives on Hetauda-Kathmandu road
items.desc: Three people died in Thursday’s jeep crash, a week after a microbus accident killed 14 in Bhimphedi. The 82-km route has seen 30 crashes and 22 deaths this fiscal year alone.

items.title: Nepal and Bangladesh to play historic T20I at Lord’s in June
items.desc: The fixture, which is historic for both countries, will take place as part of the MCC-hosted Nepal tour to England, where the Rhinos will play against Scotland and Ireland.

items.title: CIB obtains arrest warrant for former chief secretary over Malaysia worker scam
items.desc: Six people, including two former labour ministers, have been arrested over allegations that money collected illegally from Nepali workers was sent to Malaysia.

items.title: ANFA suspension lifted after months of restrictions
items.desc: The National Sports Council reverses its action against the football governing body as Nepal seeks to address concerns raised by international football authorities.

items.title: Bhandari accuses government of targeting political opponents, media
items.desc: Former president Bidya Devi Bhandari says due process and democratic freedoms are being undermined, urging political parties to unite in defence of the constitution.

items.title: Three killed, seven injured in jeep crash in Makawanpur
items.desc: The passenger vehicle veered off the Hetauda-Bhaise road and plunged into a stream early Thursday while travelling from Rautahat to Kathmandu.

items.title: Trump says historic summit with Xi, Putin already a ‘win’ before event
items.desc: A lavish welcome in China sets the stage for talks that analysts say are unlikely to bridge deep divisions over trade, Ukraine and nuclear weapons.

items.title: Chocolate offers a special taste of China, one bite at a time
items.desc: From models of city landmarks to tea-infused treats, businesses are giving a familiar confection a fresh twist.

items.title: Long-awaited Ring Road’s Kalanki-Basundhara section widening yet to take off
items.desc: More than eight years after the project was agreed, work on the 8.2-kilometre stretch has yet to begin as China is still in the process of selecting a contractor.

items.title: Chief removal controversies leave Nepal Police leadership shaky
items.desc: Political interference, legal battles, factional rivalries and frequent changes to service rules have weakened the chain of command, undermined morale and obstructed institutional reform since the restoration of democracy in 1990.

items.title: Who gets to participate in Nepal’s creative industries?
items.desc: At a Kathmandu forum, artists and advocates highlight barriers to representation, accessibility and participation in Nepal’s creative industries.

items.title: UML prepares local polls strategy, protest plans
items.desc: Addressing over 3,400 cadres in Kathmandu, party chief KP Oli warns of possible government reprisals and urges cadres to prepare for protests.

items.title: Chitwan Rhinos knock Kathmandu Gorkhas out and progress to Qualifier 2
items.desc: Chitwan defeated Kathmandu by 61 runs and entered Qualifier 2, where Sudurpaschim Royals are waiting. Chitwan and Sudurpaschim will vie for a spot in the final on Thursday.

items.title: Gold price slides by Rs78,400 a tola in 10 months
items.desc: Stronger dollar and expectations of US interest rate hikes push international prices down. Traders say domestic rates could fall to Rs250,000 if current conditions persist.

items.title: Stop the repeated arbitrary removal of police leadership
items.desc: Successive governments have politicised police leadership, undermining institutional stability and professionalism.

items.title: MBBS entrance exam results published
items.desc: The Medical Education Commission has published the results of the October 31 entrance examination for students seeking admission to MBBS programmes in the 2026-27 academic year.

items.title: Mishara’s record century sends Chitwan into Qualifier 2
items.desc: Chitwan Rhinos beat Kathmandu Gorkhas by 61 runs in the Eliminator after Kamil Mishara smashed an unbeaten 120, the highest individual score in Nepal Premier League history.

items.title: Nepal, India to unveil 10-point vision for partnership during PM’s visit
items.desc: The document, based on ‘Samriddha Nepal, Samunnat Bharat’, aims to translate bilateral commitments into measurable outcomes.

items.title: Police is my friend?
items.desc: The slogan hangs on police walls across Nepal. A democracy should measure it by one simple test: what happens to a citizen who asks, “Under what law?”

items.title: Saudis preparing for Yemen campaign to last well into 2027
items.desc: The renewed conflict has become the ​most active front in the wider Iran war, killing and wounding thousands and displacing hundreds of thousands in Yemen while derailing Saudi Arabia’s efforts to draw ‌in non-oil investment and host global events.

items.title: Bangladesh deploys paramilitary as unrest grows over Hasina’s return
items.desc: Last week, Awami League announced a week-long programme of protests and rallies to mobilise support for ​Hasina’s return, culminating in a nationwide lockdown on November 19.
